from markdownify import MarkdownConverter, STRIP_ONE

default = MarkdownConverter().convert_pre(
    None, '\n\n  alpha\n  beta\n\n', set()
).replace('\n', '|')
one = MarkdownConverter(strip_pre=STRIP_ONE, code_language='py').convert_pre(
    None, '\n  alpha\n', set()
).replace('\n', '|')

print([default, one])
print(default)
print(one.count('|'))
